description: This file defines a grain class 'FilteredImplicitSubscriptionWithExtensionGrain' in an Orleans project, implementing an implicit stream subscription with logging and a method to retrieve an internal counter.

classes.name: FilteredImplicitSubscriptionWithExtensionGrain
classes.description: A Grain class that subscribes implicitly to a stream with filtering predicate, handles incoming stream events, and exposes a counter.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to activate the grain, set up stream subscription, and log activation.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Returns the current value of the internal counter.
